question: For compute/nirvana-agent-sandboxes, what identity does registration actually require for $.identity_cost.kind? The sign-up route returned an error page naming only an organization admin; the auth document names an organization API key issued by a dashboard owner; the startup-credits page asks for a business email and card on file but does not say registration itself requires an institution.
why: The parent-prepared claim (u302-c03) was judged unsupported; no account was created and no capture establishes the sign-up gate.
